77578.subject: Team1 Brasil Chapter Recap
77578.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/team1-brasil-chapter-recap

In 2026, Team1 Brasil underwent a period of rapid expansion scaling the local chapter team, while driving nationwide brand awareness, and accelerating Web3 adoption across South America’s largest market. By bridging mainstream cultural moments with deep technical education, the chapter has solidified its role as a primary engine for regional community growth, developer onboarding, and institutional alignment. 
Below is a comprehensive look back at our key activations, strategic partnerships, and structural milestones from this recent leg of our journey.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
Team1 Brasil Chapter Recap: Expanding LATAM’s Builder Ecosystem
Key Highlights:
Cultural and Consumer Activation: Executed a nationwide campaign alongside Bitget Wallet during the World Cup, turning World Cup excitement into real, hands-on wallet setups.
Regional Builder Labs and Executive Gatherings: Co-hosted the flagship Brasília Builder Lab with KAST and SheFi Brazil, a Leadership Breakfast in São Paulo with MetaMask, and Café Cursor in Salvador.
Institutional Depth and Developer Pipeline: Recorded an extensive technical workshop series on Real World Assets during Team1 Brasil Weekend and onboarded software engineers at Oracle through Web3 Experts Brazil.
Academic Horizon: Secured official commitments with 3 leading Brazilian universities to launch the Team1 University Connect initiative in August.
1. Merging Culture and Web3: World Cup Watch Party Series with Bitget Wallet
Bridging the gap between Web3 infrastructure and consumer adoption in Latin America requires localized, high touch community engagement. To capture this momentum, Team1 Brasil partnered with Bitget Wallet to launch the Team1 Brasil and Bitget Wallet Watch Parties Series.
Spanning 5 distinct event activations across key Brazilian cities during national team matchdays, the series served as a dual purpose initiative: a high energy cultural hub for crypto enthusiasts and a practical onboarding gateway for non crypto natives. Over 350 downloads and 700 attendees in total after all the events.
Each session featured live product demonstrations, self custody wallet setups, and interactive educational quizzes about Avalanche’s low latency network performance, demonstrating how seamless Web3 UX can integrate into everyday consumer experiences.
2. Empowering Builders: Flagship Activations in Brasília, São Paulo, and Salvador
To drive technical innovation and foster high level strategic alignment, Team1 Brasil targeted key regional tech hubs across the country:
